purpose: Process a separately frozen Nature-priority and Physical Review Letters cohort to reach at least 20 cumulative accepted recent-source Temporal benchmark families without changing scientific admission or construction rules.
interpretation: Operational benchmark production after observing 18 cumulative accepted families from EXP-TEMPORAL-PRODUCTION-001 through EXP-TEMPORAL-PRODUCTION-003. Report this cohort separately; its conversion rate is neither preregistered nor a causal estimate of a pipeline change.

source_policy.venue_priority: Process both eligible Nature records first, followed by all 49 eligible Physical Review Letters volume 137 records in their frozen audit order.
source_policy.source_requirement: The fixed versioned arXiv source response contains at least one strict UTF-8 TeX document.
source_policy.article_type_requirement: Original research must be established before freezing. Comments, Replies, Errata, Corrections, Retractions, Editorials, Reviews, Perspectives, and analogous non-original material are excluded.

time_window.date_rule: The raw-source earliest public date is the earlier of journal publication and arXiv v1. The fixed arXiv version must be public by the window end.
time_window.effective_temporal_boundary: The later of the raw-source earliest public date and a documented authoring-model knowledge cutoff. The boundary is unknown in this run because the model cutoff is unknown.

record_linkage.candidate_retrieval: Crossref relations and independent official arXiv DOI/title queries are primary retrieval channels. Quoted full-title web search is an offline supplemental retrieval channel; provider, query, time, and candidate URLs are retained in the source audit.
record_linkage.automatic_identity_evidence: The accepted records have one official arXiv journal DOI exactly equal to the canonical Crossref journal DOI.
record_linkage.manual_review_rule: Title or first-author agreement alone may only create a manual-review candidate. Search results and rankings never establish identity.
record_linkage.numeric_rule: Digits, decimal points, signs, percentages, units, exponents, chemical stoichiometric numbers, subscripts, superscripts, and mathematical symbols are preserved for adjudication. Display variants may broaden retrieval but never establish identity.

target.rule: Count at most one family per source paper, and only after a nonempty minimal ScienceCard, separate-context source-review retention, deterministic construction, and passing Identification and Discovery known-truth validation.
target.processing: Process all 51 frozen sources; do not stop when the cumulative target is reached and do not replace failures.
target.family_identifier_rule: The compiler uses frozen source order plus family_index_offset, yielding temporal_source_3001 through temporal_source_3051 and avoiding cross-cohort identifier collisions.

authoring_engine.runtime_model_label: unknown unless exposed by the session

review.execution: A Code Agent context that did not author the card reviews the fixed source packet and frozen ScienceCard.
review.independence_claim: Process separation only; this is not independent human or domain-expert review.
review.release_requirement: Human source review remains required before public benchmark release.

temporal_claim.reason: The authoring engine knowledge cutoff and immutable snapshot are not documented.
temporal_claim.prohibited_description: Post-cutoff, unseen, or contamination-free benchmark cases

occam_review.scientific_problem: Reach the requested cumulative family count while preserving record identity, source support, executability, and task validity.
occam_review.proposed_change: Add one independently frozen source cohort; do not change admission, source review, construction, or validation rules.
occam_review.simpler_alternative: Recover four construction failures from EXP-TEMPORAL-PRODUCTION-003, but each fails the paired Identification and Discovery task contract and therefore cannot validly supply the missing families.
occam_review.assumptions: The exact-DOI and TeX gates identify usable source packets, but only later extraction and review can determine whether a benchmark-suitable quantitative relation exists.
occam_review.stopping_rule: Process the complete frozen cohort once; do not add repair stages or loosen scientific gates based on intermediate yield.

main_pipeline.emergency_adapter_scope: EXP-TEMPORAL-PRODUCTION-004 only; it does not replace the API runner
